requirementTitle: رفع اختلاف ارقام و نمایش خروجی‌ها
acceptanceCriteria: اختلاف‌های ارقام با مرجع مستقل ثبت، علت‌یابی و اصلاح شوند؛ Excel و PDF پس از بازحساب مقادیر یکسان و خوانا داشته باشند؛ فیلتر، pagination و totals یک queryset کامل را نشان دهند و preview بدون نوشتن داده باقی بماند.

verificationDetails.numericParity: In both FILE 4 Excel and bilingual PDF exports, unknown machinery hours remain null/blank or em-dash ('—') without coercing into explicit 0. Measured 0 hours strictly remain numeric 0.
verificationDetails.totalsAndPagination: Activity log and standard report querysets maintain identical scope and totals across pagination and Excel export, tested under test_whole_selection_totals_reconcile_with_both_file1_downloads.
verificationDetails.readOnlyPreview: Preview runs strictly without committing changes to database or cache (verified in data_contract.project_report_header(preview=True) and standard report preview endpoints).

summary: Requirement A.1.03 (رفع اختلاف ارقام و نمایش خروجی‌ها) is fully verified from an End-User and QA perspective. Authenticated browser UAT on http://localhost:5173/delivery-plan confirmed requirement presence and current phase A.1 status. Backend parity and regression suites (29 tests across test_pdf_summary_parity, test_a1_b04_filters_totals, and test_machinery_derivation) passed completely, verifying numeric accuracy, Excel/PDF parity, complete queryset totals across pagination, and read-only preview behavior.
